findings: A stored BASE repair readback runs bind_preflight_receipt, memory as-of, and draft/context binding before returning the terminal. Production freeze also checks the current market epoch. A failed check writes nothing. AUTHORIZED retry and CLOSED readback do not skip that path. The first freeze, before a repair stamp, still writes. GROUNDED_RESULT_MISMATCH still blocks a different result.

The CLI scenario locks a legacy parent without a capability epoch or FORGE_RUN_RECEIPT through production preflight, CLI freeze, zero-write replay, AUTHORIZED reopen as RESUME_REPAIR_CONTINUATION, a close interrupt that keeps one completion receipt, resume to CLOSED, and ordinary post-close readback. Corrupt preflight, market drift, and a different grounded result are refused without new looks.
